rule: If the household has a member under 18 in the D-008 roster (same NOMER), then GR40 in [1]
quote: Gr40 | ... имеются дети не достигшие восемнадцатилетнего возраста? Да -1, нет - 2
note: Record link, household by household: a household with a member under 18 in the D-008 roster (same NOMER, same year) must have GR40 = 1. ROSTER_U18 is computed by the engine from D-008 GOD_ROJD (engine/statquo.py attach_roster). The region-level rule D002-x-D008-children compares shares; this one names the households. Added 12 Oct 2026 from the data model (schema/profile.py).
sql_first_column: WITH r AS (SELECT NOMER, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN :year - CAST(GOD_ROJD AS INT) < 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS ROSTER_U18 FROM d008_kontr_k GROUP BY NOMER) SELECT o.TE, COUNT(*) AS violations FROM d002_ocenka o JOIN r ON r.NOMER = o.NOMER WHERE r.ROSTER_U18 = 1 AND (o.GR40 IS NULL OR CAST(o.GR40 AS INT) <> 1) GROUP BY o.TE ORDER BY violations DESC;
